note: PTF-DETROIT-ANN-ARBOR-FOUNDER-RULINGS-AND-SHADOW-PROMOTION-006 PROMOTED the local-OSM shadow recensus after the founder settled the ten-municipality boundary packet and the 3764 S State St identity pair. 180 -> 257 identities: 77 newly discovered, and every one of the 180 committed identities carried forward -- UNEXPLAINED_LOSSES 0, no committed canonical name overwritten by a discovery sighting, no populated locality blanked by a thinner one. Discovery was answered entirely from the committed local Michigan extract (local_extract:geofabrik-michigan-detroit-ann-arbor): 0 network requests, $0. The EVEN Hotel / Hotel Indigo pair at 575 W Big Beaver remains TWO identities -- the same-doorway guard refuses to merge two hotels that each name their own official page. Canton is HELD by founder judgement, so its 5 candidates are reported MARKET_MEMBERSHIP_UNRESOLVED rather than admitted or excluded. 11 newly discovered rows were WITHHELD from this promotion: their OpenStreetMap name tag is the BRAND ALONE, so the identity key derived from it is a brand and cannot distinguish two buildings in two markets -- two of them already collided with Cleveland's census. They are real hotels with real addresses and first-party property pages, and they are held in detroit_ann_arbor_under_determined_identities_006.json for a pass that reads each property page for the name it gives itself. Composing a name from a URL fragment would invent the identity this census exists to record. 2 name(s) carried a double-encoded non-breaking space from the OSM extract; the whitespace was normalised and the identity key re-derived from the corrected name. A non-breaking space IS a space: this is transcription, not a rename. 'Bell Tower Hotel' (discovery) merged into the committed 'The Bell Tower Hotel': one hotel, one belltowerhotel.com domain, differing only by a leading article. Street-identity absorption could not see it because the committed row states no address -- which is exactly what the discovery row supplied. 3 rows share a street identity with another and are flagged SHARED_ADDRESS. None was merged: each names its own official property page, and the same-doorway rule is that distinct first-party pages are the operators' own statement that these are distinct properties. Promotion may ADD identities and FILL blanks; it may not downgrade a fact a reviewed build already established. 1251 committed field values were restored after the first promotion pass took the OpenStreetMap website tag over the committed, ROUTING_CONFIRMED official_url on 64 rows and blanked it on 23 more. Where discovery stated a DIFFERENT URL the committed one wins and the disagreement is recorded in detroit_ann_arbor_promotion_url_conflicts_006.json rather than resolved by whichever record happened to be written last.
